blocks.cap: Voting made easy and convenient at Robinsons Manila

blocks.html: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) continues its long-standing partnership with Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) as 13 Robinsons Malls nationwide, covering 152 polling precincts, are officially designated as Mall Voting Precincts (MVPs) for the upcoming May 12 Mid-Term National Elections.

This initiative, in collaboration with Robinsons Malls’ Lingkod Pinoy Center, aims to enhance the voting experience for eligible voters in the selected precincts. In addition to the convenience of casting ballots in accessible and comfortable locations, voters can enjoy various mall amenities for post-voting activities such as dining, shopping, or spending quality time with family.

The strategic partnership between RLC and COMELEC dates back to 2014, when Robinsons Malls became the first mall chain in the country to host off-site voter registration, offering services such as biometric capture, issuance of voter certificates, and voter IDs. “Since then, we’ve been hosting satellite voter registration and were honored to be the inaugural venue for the Register Anywhere Program. We are optimistic that this program will encourage more Filipinos to exercise their right to vote,” said Joel Lumanlan, Vice President for Operations and Marketing at Robinsons Malls.

The Robinsons Malls with voting precincts include Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Las Piñas, Robinsons Malabon, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Iloilo, Robinsons Jaro, Robinsons Roxas, Robinsons Dumaguete, and Robinsons CDO. These malls will open early at 7:00 a.m. on election day.
